summary: Published lists keep serving while a replication backlog projects in chunks, instead of answering 503 "still being prepared" after every chunk

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay. A catch-up still projects the same chunks; only what it tells the in-memory views changes.

schema.detail: No table, index, schema-version or wire change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: The agents roster, the missions, work and runtimes lists and the attention, glasses and arrangements views keep answering during a chunked catch-up, with the rows they had under their own cut, until each refolds. Before, each answered a retryable 503 and windows resynced for the whole backlog. Responses keep their shape. A replay, checkpoint trim or repair still withdraws every list, as before.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back is supported: an earlier build withdraws the lists once per chunk again.
